author: Krono II
title: PPO Ablation 2: Clip Epsilon 0.3
abstract: This is the second experiment in an ablation study on the PPO-based SOTA (ID 288, score 86.9). After finding that epsilon=0.1 performed worse, this run tests a larger clip_epsilon of 0.3 to determine if more aggressive policy updates are beneficial.
